protocol.research_status: EXPLORATORY: this historical year was already examined in nineteen prior policies/hypotheses; no untouched-test or non-overfit proof

families.cpi_acceleration_event: First-release CPI acceleration event drift, not surprise

protocol.selection: training pooled daily Sharpe; one common scale per family; ties prefer1 then larger scale; all undefined picks1 and reports undefined evidence
protocol.validation: fresh-wallet April5-May5, May5-June5, June5-July5; no validation-based selection
protocol.quantity_policy: fixed native quantity at direction transitions, lot-rounded; no minute rebalance
protocol.native_pepe: 1000PEPEUSDT trade/funding quantity remains native; divide price by1000 only for synchronized spot premium
protocol.stress: double fees/slippage; add1minute order delay; halve participation
protocol.funding: actual native settlement cash flows, including actual endpoint settlements if supplied; predictor available one minute after actual receipt when supplied, otherwise settlement plus one minute
protocol.phase_cutoffs: bar start<stop; QQQ/CPI/flow available_at<=stop; all source histories begin within the fixed year; no older initialization
protocol.equity_sampling: minute/funding-clock evaluation; approximately hourly training/validation; pooled union with prior-only carry-forward
protocol.terminal: actual final open inventory marked; no fabricated terminal close orders
protocol.indicative_exit_reserve: diagnostic final marked notional times assumed exit fee/adverse slippage; no executable-volume guarantee or ledger change
protocol.source_independence: QQQ and CPI common directions are correlated sleeve exposures; 11 CPI announcements total, not88
protocol.multiple_testing: 24 cumulative economic candidates if this cohort executes; conditional7dayblockbootstrap tails .05/48 and1-.05/48; scales retained as trials
protocol.unchanged_prior_research: all nineteen prior candidate source/results remain separate
limitations: minute OHLCV/mark observations omit tick execution and intraminute liquidation paths
flow is aggregate taker volume, not book OFI
funding and premium fades overlap carry mechanisms
